findings: The only local draw-sized groups intersecting the normal-tail ROI are repeated upper strip passes at tbp0=12384 and tbp0=12448.
No small/local draw group covers the lower visible normal-tail body in the focus ROI, so the body cannot be patched from a simple local strip owner.
Broad clipped groups overlap the focus ROI, but remain rejected as a renderer patch basis without texture-alpha raster ownership or source-object mapping.

Current source materials show normal lane tails use tail_%s.mat -> gem_star.tex with texgen=5, while RuntimeMesh does not currently carry tex_gen; this is a follow-up investigation target, not a patch basis yet.
